about: Mae Hong Son province (Mae Sariang, Salawin National Park), northern Thailand. Pass of 2026-11-02: nothing verified.

leads.name: Giant teak in Salawin National Park care, Mae Khun Yuam
leads.note: Register: 450+ years, girth 8.40 m (68 m height rejected as implausible), cared for by Salawin National Park. Wikipedia says only that Thailand's second-largest teak is in the park; no size, location or trail on that page or on thaiholidayguide. Park fee 100 THB foreign adult, 08:30 to 16:30, phone 0 5204 0266 (thaiholidayguide, not official). No alive evidence dated, no trail found, register pin approximate.
